notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You have at least eight cards in hand, or an opponent except the opponent directly to your right has at least six cards in hand.
Your deck size is less than 90, or each opponent has a deck size of 91 or less.
description:
Cast Pure Intentions by paying {W}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Pure Intentions.
Resolve all Pure Intentions.
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Windfall.
Resolve the first opponent's copy of Windfall, causing each player to discard their hand and draw cards equal to the greatest number of cards discarded this way.
Each player who did not control Windfall's Pure Intentions triggers.
Resolve all Pure Intentions, causing you and the opponents to return to their hand all cards discarded by Windfall.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining Windfall until you either draw from an empty library, causing you to win the game due to Jace, or until your opponents lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
